baselineRule: The first reviewed exact-candidate Windows receipt establishes the baseline only after one complete, unmeasured profile-preparation lifecycle and exactly five fully closed process-cold launches against that prepared profile. Every preparation and measured launch must prove two visible sandboxed windows and zero-survivor teardown; no sample may be retried or discarded. The median of all five recorded launches is the budget metric. Missing, unverified, non-exact, or nonconforming measurements fail closed.
